epilogueBeats: [d156] The table notes 2 ascensions from one village — its terms improve accordingly. Nobody has ever seen that before.

[d156] ◈ OUTSHONE — Eduardo Epstein and Marcus Webb did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.

[d156] ◈ THE PANTHEON — Eduardo Epstein and Marcus Webb ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.
